newsitem.title: USA: Aetna in long-term NY health system pact.
newsitem.headline: Aetna in long-term NY health system pact.

text.p: Aetna Inc's Aetna U.S. Healthcare said on Wednesday that the North Shore Health System will be a part of the company's network of participating health care providers in New York, effective August 1.

Under the agreement, all of the eight hospitals of Long Island's North Shore Health System will be available to members enrolled in all Aetna U.S. Healthcare products, the Aetna Corp unit said in a statement.

"The agreement between Aetna U.S. Healthcare and the North Shore Health System solidifies our relationship and signifies a major milestone in the development of a long-term strategic alliance," David Florman, Aetna U.S. Healthcare's Long Island General Manager, said in a statement.
